system.description:
You conjure your lightning release chakra until you create a wall of lightning that you can place on a solid surface or suspend midair. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 15 feet high and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 40 feet in diameter, 15 feet high, and 1 feet thick. This wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 lighting damage and becomes Shocked or half as much damage and no further effects on a successful save.

On both sides of the wall each creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of it takes 4d8 Lighting damage and must make a Constitution saving throw gaining 1 rank of Shocked on a failed save. A creature takes the same damage and gains the same condition when it enters the wall for the first time or ends its turn there.

The wall has 5d6 hit points and intercepts all attacks or affects that would need to pass through it to take effect. It has resistance to Earth damage and vulnerability to Wind damage.
